entry_points.text: Diagnostics report identity, range, depth, flags, write bounds and extents and flag index past last; injection builds per-action errors; module creates and removes directory.
Primary calls are create, keyed get and put, stats snapshots and hint derive with releases.
Derives mask from capacity, fills ring with tail and last from contiguous memory, links totals, runs optional init and aborts on failure.

exports.text: Concat counts two arrays, allocates plus terminator and fills from tail; region alloc and free; endian safe bit count head, words, tail; bounded scan; strict MAC or untouched; wide multiply from halves with carry.
Heap shims for init, peek, full, sift up and down, build, pop, replace, push and indexed delete with size and context.

Intervals from width group extremes plus selectors; shared validate and parse walk with policy and table; find, zero filling copy, length ordered compare ignoring trailing zero, normalized dup, padded safe copy with truncation; policy size sums aligned entries.
Normal, 64-bit aligned and headerless builds; unchecked advances tail with header and zeroed pad; checked fails with null or size status without change including extra alignment.
Mask trigger with local inline and remote raise; per-CPU handler clears bit; wrapper forwards mask; root, delta and key accessors; tracepoints enabled.

Manager needs callbacks; create and destroy handle hints, hash and ids; get reuses, put destroys on zero removing list and hash; snapshots ordered roots first then delta and user; hints with coverage and refcount from one with reclaim on zero; root ids hinted or sentinel; init hint, parent then root with fallback; hash on embedded bytes.
Validation from first leaf in postorder with parent, limit, child, gap and null checks; hash plain delegates, general syncs, walks successors, optionally releases elements and frees nested.

hazards.text: Concat null on alloc failure; incomplete callbacks, live teardown and coverage mismatch warn with invalid; failures unwind ids, finalization, flushes and hash frees in reverse.
Bounded ten second wait then late mask warning with stall check; idle CPUs may skip emission but clear pending and report handled.
Word size 32 with half base and selectors; max nested policy depth 10; invalid root id sentinel when no hints.
External helpers used as interfaces only; internals owned elsewhere.

invariants.text: Non-root appears once at parent slot with back pointer; interior supplies child per slot with index; pivots ordered in range with empty tail; leaves forbid adjacent empties, enforce occupancy, reject dead and check gaps.

Fixed widths with nested and wide minima; bitfield needs mask and rejects outside bits; arrays skip empties and recurse; top guards depth and strict unknowns; per attribute checks length, nested flag and kind rules.

Dispatch unsigned and signed kinds to matching checkers, rejecting others; unsigned uses width decode with endian or length, signed decodes width; both fail outside interval; mask fails on reserved bits.

Callback matches action and converts error; debugfs clamps to negated max to zero; refs by one; stats touch total, delta and parent; root is null parent; lookups hash; test allows child above parent within bound with distinct errors.

Zero removes from list and hash; teardown with live warns; root ids allocator only with hints else sentinel with unhinted after hint total; parentless hint is root, parented reuses with fallback and lookup failure propagates; weight sums feasible successors, max favors later ties; hint nodes carry counts with sequential root ids; test counts with copy.

locks.text: Write exclusion for validation; hash teardown avoids mutex, syncs work and uses raw access to prevent reclaim cycle.
Single flag bit for single flight with loser return; print sync serializes output allowing nested same CPU entries.

state_machines.text: Acquire single flight, dup mask, dump local, announce and raise, poll with watchdog, warn late with stall check, flush and release; cursor distinguishes idle through error plus store kinds.

Scan list for accepting root; assignment links with delta store and trace on success else unlinked; birth lookup, create, init, hash, list; death on zero with delta or root finalize; greedy builds graph then repeatedly picks max uncrossed root with neighbours until empty then destroys.
Walk current and successor tables; with callback walk each chain with rescheduling invoking on each object.

structs.text: Memory holds online and offline actions with block, priority and directory; net device holds registration, mtu, name, up, type, init and upper actions; actions pair value, error and name ending with zero sentinel.
Managers hold ops, hash, list, counts and alloc; entries embed hash and list links, parent, root id, stats and trailing keys with delta or root union and refcount.
Temp nodes with back pointer and crossed flag plus square feasibility matrix with row major index; fill operation with greedy table by id; hash params store key length and offsets.
Nested teardown derives fanout, reaches top without protection, recurses by page size and frees plain tables after nested.
